notes: A firm line on mature images. An 18+ picture whose description reads under-age — 'teen', 'girl', a stated age below 20, and similar — is now refused outright at the single point every image engine passes through: no generation, no fallback, a clear toast and log line naming the word that tripped it. Characters also now describe themselves with an explicit adult age in their twenties or older. Mature mode is for unambiguously adult characters; that has always been the premise, and the app now enforces it.
